title: Course detail meeting type is lost when type has no code attribute
reasoning: parseMeetingsXml only matches a meeting type element when it contains a code attribute, and both type and typeCode are read from that one match. The included cascade fixture documents CISAPI cascade responses with plain <type>Lecture</type>, while the course-detail test only covers the coded form. Course-detail XML with a plain type element will return an empty meeting type even though the text is present.
reproduction: Call parseCourseDetailXml with a detailedSection meeting containing <type>Lecture</type> and no code attribute; sections[0].meetings[0].type is ''.
recommendation: Parse the type text independently from the optional code attribute, so <type>Lecture</type> yields type='Lecture' and typeCode='' while preserving coded type behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests exercise code-less type elements only through parseSubjectCascadeXml; the parseCourseDetailXml regression uses <type code="LEC"> and therefore misses the regex requirement.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a parseCourseDetailXml test with <type>Lecture</type> and assert meeting.type is 'Lecture' and meeting.typeCode is ''.
minimumFixScope: apps/api/src/cisapi/parser.ts parseMeetingsXml type matching plus one course-detail parser test.
